content: Dule-baidgi-nosar ibmar-ukleged
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Dule-gwensak dule-baidgi-nosad-ular Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-uked bur-ise-islidikid gued. Weyobi, ega igar megoed:
Bia ibmar-durgan-ogumakar-ukleged-e-dukar egwallege, agi dule-baidgi-nosad-ular-ibmar-uklenaid-e-dukar egwallemogoed. Geb e-abe ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-aila-e-dikarmargi bomi-bomi imakoed.
Geb sorbali, bela ibmar-uklenaid-e-gwallu Bab-Jehováʼga uklegoed:
” ’Geb sorbali, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled bela wemar ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ogumakar Bab-Jehováʼga ukoed. We-ibmala, isgued-ular ogumakar-uklegedid.
We-ibmar bela dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-gormalad-e-gwenadgan-machergan nabir gunmaloed. We-ibmar nega-islidikidgi gunmaloed. We, ibmar-bur-ise-islidikidid.’ ”
Dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladga ibmar-uklegoed

Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Isgued-ular-ibmar-uklegedga, degi, dule-baidgi-nosad-ular-ibmar-uklegedga, unnila igar-soggwenna megoed. Dule-baidgi-nosad-ular ibmar-uklenaidi, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-ibmar-imaknaidgadga guoed.
We-ibdurgan-uklenaid-e-uka dule-irwa-Babse-goled-ibmar-imaknaidgadga guoed.
Amba deyobbali, madubur soogi-yoaled, madubur bormogi-dualed, degi, madubur bormogi-dibyaled, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-ibmar-imaknaidgadga gubaloed.
Bela ibmar-gwag-Bab-Dummadga-ukleged, olivo-gwalluba-omukualeddibe, dinnagwaddibe, Aarón, e-masmalamala, na emarbi-mergu sumaloed.’ ”
Dule-gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sogdebalid: “Israel-dulemarga be sogo: ‘Dule-gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-e-igar weyob megoed:

Dule Bab-Jehováʼga dog-nuedye-sogega ibmar-uknaile, we-ibmar-uknaid-ukine, madu-olo-e-inasuli-olivo-gwalluba-omukualed, madu-matargana-e-inasuli-olivo-gwallugi magaled, degi, madubur-bur-nuedgi-madu-ologana-dibyar olivo-gwalluba-omukualed ukbaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼga-dog-nuedye-sogega ibmar-uklenaidmala, degi, gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-uklenaidmala, madu-ologana e-inaba-imakar Bab-Jehováʼga uklebaloed.
Bab-Jehováʼga ukegala, bela we-ibmarmar-uklegedi, sog-soggwen sulegoed. Geb gwenatigwar-guega dule-irwa-Babse-goled ibmar-e-abe bomi-bomi-imaksadga we-ibmarmar guoed.
” ’Bab-Jehováʼga-dog-nuedye-sogega we-san uklesadi, a-ibagi gullegoed, banedgala bipisaar san sabolegosulid.

” ’Ar Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-uklenaidi, dule ibmar-imakedseye sogsagusad-ular uklenadibe, igi Bab-Jehováʼga na ibmar-ukbiedba uklenadibe, adi, a-ibagi a-san gullegoed. Ar san-obichardi, sunna bangi gullebaloed.
Ar ibapaagi, we-san amba bukwale, bela soogi ogumaklegoed.

” ’Ar dule ibapaagi gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-e-san guchale, we-ibmar-uklesadi, Bab-Jehová bar abingaosulid, bar ega igarga guosulid. Ar ade, we-san swilidiksuli gunonikoed. Dule we-san-guchadi, nue-dummad-isgusye soglegoed.
” ’We-sangi ibmar-swilidiksulid warmaksale, we-san bar gullegosulid, soogi ogumaklegoed. San-baiddi, bela dule-san-swilidik-gudimalad sunna gunmaloed.
” ’Dule-san-swilidiksuli-gudiid, gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-uklenaid-e-san guchale, e-dulemar-abargi onolegoed. Ar we-sande, Bab-Jehováʼgadid.

” ’Deginbali, dule ibmar-isgana-dulegad-ebusale, ibdurgan-e-ibmar-isgana-ebusale, ibmar-ised-isgana-ebusale, geb a-sorbali, gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-uklesad-e-san gunnele, we-dule, e-dulemar-abargi onolegoed. Ar we-sande, Bab-Jehováʼgadid.’ ”
Ibdurgan-e-gwallu, degi, e-abe-imaklegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be soge: ‘Moli-bebe-nikad-machered-e-gwallu, sibad-wawaad-bipigwad-e-gwallu, degi, sibad-ome-e-gwallu, bemar bipisaar gunmalosulid.
Ibdurgan-sapurbalid-ursirmarse ibmar-burgwisad-e-gwallu, ese oichimaklesad-e-gwalludibe, mer be gunmalo. A-gwallumardi sunna ibmar-bamaladga be ebumaloed.
” ’Dule Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-e-gwallu guchale, we-dule, e-dulemar-abargi onolegoed.
” ’Deginbali, bia bemar maigumaloe, agi bemar bipisaar nuumar-abe, baid-ibdurgan-abedibe, gunmalosulid.
Ar doa-dule ibu-abe guchale, we-dule, e-dulemar-abargi onolegoed.’ ”
Dule-irwa-Babse-gormaladga ibmar-uklegoed
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga sunmakdebalid, ega sogded:
“Israel-dulemarga be soge: ‘Dule, gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-ukele, we-dule, Bab-Jehová-asabin we-ibmar-ukleged abar sedoed.
Deginbali, we-dule, e-sunnad ibmar-ogumakar-uklegoedi, Bab-Jehová-asabin sedbaloed. Ibmar-e-gwallu, degi, e-binasgar sedoed. Geb binasgar Bab-Jehová-asabin bana-bana-imaklear ukoed.
Dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled ibmar-e-gwallu ibmar-ogumakar-ukleged-ailagi ogumakoed. Moli-e-binasgardi Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga uklegoed.
Dule-gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-e-dua-nuedsikidi, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-ibmar-imaknaidga uklegoed.
Dule-irwa-Babse-goled dule-gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-e-abe-uknaidi, degi, e-gwallu-uknaidi, we-ibmar-e-dua-nuedsikid suoed.

Israel-dulemar gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-ukleged-e-binasgar-bana-bana-imakleged, degi, e-dua, dule-irwa-Babse-goled-Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga, ani Bab-Jehová, an uksad. We-igala, degisadegu Israel-dulemarga mai guoed.’ ”
Bab-Jehová dule-irwa-ese-goledga, Aarón, degi, e-masmala-nug-imaksad-iba-akale, we-ibmar-Bab-Jehováʼga-ogumakar-uklegedi, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga ukleged-igar megnonikid.
We-dulemar-nug-imaklesad-ibagi, Bab-Jehová Israel-dulemarga igar-uksad, Aarónʼga, degi, e-masmalaga we-ibmarmar ukmaloye. We-igar, degisadegu Israel-waganga mai guoed.

Deginbali, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-ogumakar-uklegedsik, Bab-Jehováʼga-ibmar-gwag uklegedsik, isgued-ular ibmar-ogumakar-uklegedsik, weyob igar megisad. Deginbali, dule-baidgi-nosar ibmar-uklegedsik, dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-golega nugsalenair ibmar-uklegedsik, degi, gwenatigwar-guega ibmar-uklegedsik, weyob igar megisad.
Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga we-igar Sinaí-yalagi uksa gusad. Deunni, Israel-dulemar Sinaí-nega-dulesulidganba gudimargu, Bab-Jehová Moisésʼga ega-ibmar-ukleged-igar uksagusad.
